objective.value: Use English confidently for meaningful professional, social and real-world communication.
objective.qualifier: The journey keeps fluency at the center while helping language become more precise and reusable.

focus.value: Precision inside fluency: clearer sentence framing, stronger collocations, lexical retrieval and structured opinions.
focus.qualifier: Recent lessons show that meaningful discussion is already a strong foundation for the next stage.

whatChanged.title: English is working across more real-world contexts
whatChanged.summary: Across professional projects, Diversity & Inclusion and extended current-affairs discussion, Louise keeps communication moving while using support to refine vocabulary and phrasing. The next stage is to make that already-functional English more precise and structured.
whatChanged.evidence: Source-grounded lessons from 2 March, 22 April, 1 June and 20 July 2026.

priorities.title: Make fluent ideas more precise
priorities.why: Keep the natural flow of conversation while improving sentence framing, collocations, prepositions and verb patterns that make complex ideas easier to follow.

priorities.title: Structure professional explanations
priorities.why: Use clear purpose → people → challenge → action → result framing when explaining real projects and workplace situations.

priorities.title: Keep the message alive while searching for words
priorities.why: Use paraphrase and reformulation before receiving a missing word, then reuse the new expression inside the same conversation.
priorities.evidence: April, June and July repair/retrieval episodes.

nextAction.outcome: Deliver an extended opinion or professional explanation, then refine only the highest-value precision points.
nextAction.title: Meaning First, Precision Next
nextAction.description: Start with an uninterrupted 2–3 minute explanation on a meaningful professional or current topic. Then revisit only two or three high-value language points and try the message again with clearer structure and more precise wording.
nextAction.evidence: The source-grounded journey shows strong sustained communication and productive lexical repair across meaningful adult contexts.

progressTracker.title: Keeping ideas moving
progressTracker.insight: Louise sustains meaningful conversation across professional, social and current-affairs topics, even when she needs to search for a word.

progressTracker.title: Professional English in real situations
progressTracker.insight: English has been used to explain real workplace themes such as inclusion, event organization, institutional processes and organizational change.

progressTracker.title: Finding and reusing precise language
progressTracker.insight: Louise notices vocabulary gaps, asks for language and returns to the message. The next step is making more of that language available without interrupting the idea.

progressTracker.title: Precision inside fluency
progressTracker.insight: Sentence framing, collocations, prepositions and verb patterns are the main places where small refinements can make already-strong communication clearer.

progressTracker.title: Structuring longer opinions
progressTracker.insight: A clear opening, two reasons or examples and a conclusion can make complex viewpoints even easier to follow.

classReports.title: Class Report — 02 Mar 2026
classReports.summary: Louise began this cycle with a clear purpose: keep English active through regular, meaningful conversation and continued use.
classReports.teacherInsight: This episode establishes Louise's learning purpose and gives later lessons a meaningful longitudinal starting point.

classReports.title: Class Report — 22 Apr 2026
classReports.summary: Louise used English to explore workplace inclusion and organizational culture, connecting professional ideas with vocabulary such as inclusion, thrive, boost and innovation.
classReports.teacherInsight: Professional meaning gives Louise a strong route into abstract vocabulary and creates useful language for future discussion.

classReports.title: Class Report — 01 Jun 2026
classReports.summary: Louise used English to explain a real inclusive-business event, from its social purpose to logistics, public institutions, sponsorship and organizational change.
classReports.teacherInsight: The lesson shows English functioning as a real professional communication tool. The next gain is clearer structure and precision without reducing spontaneity.

classReports.title: Class Report — 20 Jul 2026
classReports.summary: Louise sustained a long, intellectually demanding conversation across current-affairs and social topics while actively negotiating vocabulary and phrasing.
classReports.teacherInsight: The strongest evidence is sustained meaning-making. The next step is to make that already-functional communication more precise and economical.

goals.title: Keep meaningful fluency strong
goals.description: Continue using English for ideas that matter, especially professional, social and current topics.

goals.title: Make precision easier inside spontaneous speech
goals.description: Improve a small number of recurring collocations, prepositions, verb patterns and sentence frames without interrupting the message.

goals.title: Structure longer explanations
goals.description: Use clear openings, reasons/examples and conclusions in opinions and professional debriefs.

goals.title: Strengthen lexical retrieval strategies
goals.description: Paraphrase first, then reuse new vocabulary inside the same communicative thread.

grammarOverview.title: Language Precision (Cumulative)
grammarOverview.summary: Louise already communicates effectively in extended spontaneous conversation. The next phase is contextual refinement rather than elementary grammar coverage.
focusPoints: Use clearer sentence framing in longer explanations.
Strengthen high-value collocations and prepositions that recur in meaningful conversation.
Refine verb patterns while keeping the message moving.
Use reformulation and a second attempt after extended speaking rather than interrupting every idea.
Organize longer opinions with an opening position, reasons/examples and a conclusion.

teacherFeedback.title: Teacher Insight
teacherFeedback.body: Louise's strongest learning route is meaningful conversation. She already uses English to think through professional and social ideas. The next phase is to make the language carrying those ideas more precise, structured and readily retrievable.
